title: Non-Slide Continuity & Spatial Motion Grammar
antiSlidePrinciples: Never fade Beat A out to an empty void before fading Beat B in — connect beats via continuous camera flight, shared-subject morphing, portal zoom, foreground occlusion wipes, or purposeful rhythmic match cuts.
Drive camera moves with physical acceleration curves (expoInOut / whipIn) and pair peak-velocity pans with proportional directional motion blur.
Use extreme foreground occluders (closest to camera, softly defocused, fastest parallax) to create immediate spatial depth.
Evolve depth-of-field focus and light/color polarity (dark <-> light, cool <-> warm) continuously along the emotional arc.

architectures.name: Continuous 3D World Camera
architectures.whenToUse: Multi-beat explainers, conceptual essays, layered spatial storytelling
architectures.mechanism: Place beat nodes in a shared 3D coordinate space (x, y, z, rx, ry, rz) and fly a deterministic camera between keyframes with directional blur and foreground parallax.

architectures.name: Camera-Tracked Kinetic Typography
architectures.whenToUse: High-velocity hooks, manifesto intros, punchy rhythm shifts
architectures.mechanism: Unfold words along a visual reading path while the camera tracks the active word and triggers background polarity flips on key beats.

architectures.name: Single-Subject State Morph
architectures.mechanism: Keep one primary visual subject on screen and continuously transform its geometry, cross-section, color temperature, and lighting across the full film.

architectures.name: Unified Mechanical / Radial Rig
architectures.mechanism: Mount items onto a shared rotating dial or track so the active item scales into crisp focus while neighbors recede.

architectures.name: Portal Zoom & Anchor Match Cut
architectures.whenToUse: Seamless transitions across worlds, apps, or physical scales
architectures.mechanism: Push into a screen, window, letterform, or geometric anchor until it fills the frame and resolves directly into the next environment.
